variant.author: Nesrie
variant.changelog:
WachuMakeyMaking takes what you have in your inventory and calculates the optimal combination of items to make.
Item prices are fetched from Universalis, or can be manually overridden.

Make the most with what you have!

variant.name: WachuMakeyMaking?
variant.punchline: A mod that calculates what you can do with what you have.
